name: Swap
description: A two-state toggle that swaps its on and off content, such as a sun and a moon: a native checkbox with an accessible name over the content, with an optional fade or rotate. No Claude Design spec; token-driven like Grid and Stack.

livewire.name: swap
capabilities: wire:model binds checked on the native checkbox (D-018)
The 2.x true and false slots and true-icon and false-icon props still work as on, off, on-icon and off-icon

props.name: checked
props.description: Whether it is on: the on content shows. Livewire binds it with wire:model, Vue with v-model:checked; React pairs it with onCheckedChange.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: The initial state of an uncontrolled swap.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the checkbox, such as "Dark mode". It is not shown.
props.a11y: Name the setting, not the icon: "Dark mode", checked or not, rather than "Moon".

props.name: onIcon
props.description: The icon shown when on. The on slot overrides it. Livewire's 2.x true-icon still works.

props.name: offIcon
props.description: The icon shown when off. The off slot overrides it. Livewire's 2.x false-icon still works.

props.name: transition
props.description: How the content swaps: a cross-fade, a fade with a quarter turn, or at once. Reduced motion always swaps at once. Emitted as data-transition.

props.name: size
props.description: The square target (control heights sm, md, lg) and its icon (16, 16, 20px). Emitted as data-size.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part: { root, control, on, off }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The square target. It holds the checkbox and both contents in one grid cell; data-state is checked or unchecked.

parts.name: control
parts.description: The native checkbox, transparent over the target, named by label. Attributes other than class land here.

parts.name: on
parts.description: Shown when checked. aria-hidden: the checkbox carries the state.

slots.name: on
slots.description: Content shown when on, in place of onIcon. Livewire's 2.x true slot still works.

slots.name: off
slots.description: Content shown when off, in place of offIcon. Livewire's 2.x false slot still works.

events.name: checked-change
events.description: The swap turned on or off.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to and from it.

requirements: A native input type=checkbox stays in the DOM over the target, so the platform handles keyboard and screen readers and the state is announced as checked or not checked.
The checkbox has an accessible name (label) that names the setting; the swapping content is aria-hidden.
The target is at least 24×24px (2.5.8) and shows a focus ring while the checkbox has :focus-visible.
The fade and rotate are removed under prefers-reduced-motion.
